what: Several words stacked in one slot swap one at a time every 2.25s beat — the new word rises from 80px below tilted 7° over 1.5s expo.out and stands straight, while in the same beat the current word slips 50px up tilting −3°. The slot shows only one line’s height, so entering and leaving words are clipped at the slot edge. With four words one loop takes 9s, and it pauses when off screen

options.from: Distance below where it starts entering — a px number, or a ratio of the word height like 140%, default 80
options.to: Fade-out end distance (negative for top) — px or %, default -50
options.skew-out: End tilt when dropping out (deg), default -3
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.16,1,0.3,1”, default expo.out
options.--fx-align: Word horizontal alignment (via style), default center
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Words to overlap (children, two or more) — the first element inside moves, and if it is text only, the motion part wraps it in a span

use: One changing wordTwo changing wordsThree changing words

from.where: index.html .fo-words (the slot between ‹first word ··· last word› — original changing-text four words, from y80 skewY7 · to y−50 skewY−3 1.5s expo.out, stagger 2.25 repeatDelay 7.5)
